parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is purely that they are type aliases with no fields — not that they alias the same underlying type or share meaningful logic. `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are distinct widget view aliases serving different WidgetKit size roles (systemSmall, systemMedium, systemLarge) and a header component; collapsing them would destroy the intentional per-size entry-point separation required by WidgetKit's `TimelineEntry` view architecture.
